# Supplementary runtime notices

`react-remove-scroll-bar@2.3.8` declares MIT in its published package, but the npm tarball omits the license file. Its full notice is retained here from the upstream repository at commit `7301c160fda44cb8cf2b9fdfde61efad35736196`, retrieved 2026-10-08:

https://github.com/theKashey/react-remove-scroll-bar/blob/7301c160fda44cb8cf2b9fdfde61efad35736196/LICENSE

The published package reports source commit `b3b1287aad81def2e2ae707274b74531b61ddbaf`; the supplementary notice was added upstream later. The generator copies installed license/notice files for every other distributed dependency, preserving the additional Feather MIT notice bundled with Lucide. It fails if a package has neither an installed nor a version-specific supplementary notice.
